num_nodes: <int> Total number of nodes in the undirected graph.
num_edges: <int> Total number of edges in the undirected graph.
bisection_capacity_F: <int> Maximum allowable sum of node weights in each partition group.
total_node_weight: <int> Sum of all node weights across the graph.
node_weights: <list[int], length num_nodes> Weight of each node, indexed by node identifier.
edges: <list[list[int]], shape [num_edges][2]> Pair of endpoint node identifiers for each edge.
edge_weights: <list[int], length num_edges> Cost associated with cutting each edge, in the same order as edges.
